English: Warrior Patch
A roughly cleared patch of earth, marked by banners and crude totems, where young warriors gather to test their mettle and share tales around the fire.
Training Circle
A well-trodden ring of packed dirt, surrounded by simple wooden posts and woven grass mats, where warriors spar and elders instruct.
Weapons Pavilion
A large hide tent reinforced with timber poles, storing honed blades, bows, and armor, and serving as a gathering place for warriors before battle.
Battlefield Tent
A grand command tent, lined with battle-scored banners and maps, where warbands gather to plan their next conquest.
Command Stand
A raised timber platform, adorned with carved standards, used for mustering the horde and issuing commands before great raids.
Muster Hall
A sturdy, timber-walled hall, filled with trophies and banners, where the bravest warriors gather for feasts and mustering before war.
Elite Ground
A fenced, well-drained field reserved for the training and parade of the hordes elite, ringed with banners and guarded day and night.
Champions Pavilion
A lavish, decorated tent city where the greatest warriors dwell, filled with symbols of glory and places for guests from distant tribes.
Chiefs Chamber
A tall, timber-framed lodge at the camps heart, where the chief rules and hosts councils of war, storing the wealth and banners of the horde.
Pagan Warrior Lodge

An awe-inspiring, heavily fortified wooden hall standing above all others, the sacred heart of the horde where warriors are initiated, rituals are held, and the chieftain proclaims the will of the gods.
